subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in coalescing/final-only delivery policy for tool-interleaved assistant text, and should that policy live under agent defaults, channel config, or both?
rationale: The code path is clear, but changing delivery semantics and adding config surfaces affects user-visible channel behavior and must align with the repo's high bar for new config options.

options.title: Add opt-in delivery mode
options.body: Add a default-off coalesce/final-only mode that covers final embedded-run payloads and block-streamed tool boundaries, with docs and regression tests.

options.title: Keep current model discipline path
options.body: Decline new config and rely on final_answer/commentary handling plus prompt guidance, leaving this issue to close as not planned.

options.title: Split by policy type
options.body: Keep this issue for coalescing only while routing suppression/security semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/25592 and ordering bugs to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57225.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in delivery mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off coalesce/final-only mode that covers final embedded-run payloads and block-streamed tool boundaries, with docs and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent review context on this issue and history around the reply coalescing/config documentation path.
